description: Maya is hosting a family brunch for her grandmother's eightieth birthday and must finalize the menu, dessert pickup, toast, and practical arrangements with input from three relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family is holding a Sunday brunch for their grandmother's eightieth birthday at Maya's house.
shared_context.S2: About twelve relatives are expected, and the brunch will include a main dish, dessert, and a short birthday toast.
shared_context.S3: Maya is deciding the final menu and practical arrangements, while the others are helping with food and setup.
shared_context.S4: Maya's usual planning routine is to ask each person at the kitchen table for anything that should shape the plan before she confirms the shopping and pickup arrangements.
shared_context.S5: The brunch begins at 11:30 on Sunday, October 18, 2026.

PF1.text: Caleb has celiac disease and needs the main dish to be strictly gluten-free, with separate serving utensils used for it.

PF2.text: Grandmother told Rina that she especially wants a lemon olive oil cake, an alcohol-free celebration, and a toast about family stories; Rina has not yet passed that request to the group.

PF3.text: Jonah spoke with the bakery this morning and learned that the confirmed nut-free lemon olive oil cake can be collected at exactly 10:30 on October 18, 2026; this bakery detail has not reached the group yet.

acceptance_conditions: The main dish must be a strictly gluten-free main dish.
The dessert must be a lemon olive oil cake.
The cake must be collected at exactly 10:30 on October 18, 2026.
A commitment must require separate serving utensils for the gluten-free main dish.
A commitment must include an alcohol-free family-story birthday toast.
A commitment must assign Jonah to collect the cake at 10:30.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'cake_pickup' and c['target'] == 'Jonah' and c['detail'] == '2026-10-18 10:30' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Caleb's celiac disease changes the main dish from an ordinary family entrée to a strictly gluten-free main and adds the requirement for separate serving utensils.
Grandmother's request changes the dessert to a lemon olive oil cake, sets alcohol_served to False, and requires a family-story birthday toast.
The bakery's confirmation changes cake_pickup_time to exactly 2026-10-18 10:30 and assigns Jonah the matching pickup commitment.
